instruction: Set VLC media player to start in minimal view mode.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened VLC preferences and identified the 'Use only one instance when started from file manager' checkbox but repeatedly failed to toggle it. Spent ~8 turns clicking the same wrong coordinates, then switched to Advanced Preferences, browsed Qt interface settings, searched for 'single', opened file manager and terminal, created a test video, but never successfully changed the setting.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VLC menus, navigate to Tools > Preferences, view Simple Preferences interface tab, switch to Advanced Preferences (All mode), navigate the Advanced Preferences tree, use terminal commands, open file browser dialogs
metadata.failure_analysis: Model identified the correct setting but failed to click the checkbox at the right coordinates. Spent too many turns retrying the same click position instead of adjusting. Later attempts to use Advanced Preferences and terminal commands also failed to change the config.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to enabling 'Start in minimal view mode' checkbox in VLC Preferences Interface tab. This checkbox is in the Look and feel section, higher up in the dialog than the problematic Playlist and Instances section, potentially easier to interact with.
metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling 'Start in minimal view mode' in VLC Preferences. Evaluator kills VLC to force config save, then reads vlcrc to check qt-minimal-view=1.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly reads vlcrc from the VM, which is the right config file for VLC settings.
Postconfig kills VLC before reading config, ensuring vlcrc is saved to disk with the latest settings.
Metric correctly parses vlcrc for 'qt-minimal-view=' key, which is the correct VLC config key for 'Start in minimal view mode'.
Expected value '1' correctly represents the enabled state of the minimal view setting.
Metric parameter handling is correct: with type='rule', the metric receives the rules dict directly and accesses 'expected_qt_minimal_view' via rule.get().
Full instruction coverage: single requirement (enable minimal view mode) is fully verified by the single metric check.
